The structure "(BBA220 / BBA221 / BBA226 / BBA226x)-YYYYYYYY" — probably the designation format is like IND220-YYYYYYYY or BBA220-YYYYYYYY where YYYYYYYY is defined by manufacturer. So type_designations: ["IND220", "IND221", "IND226", "IND226x", "BBA220", "BBA221", "BBA226", "BBA226x"].
